title: Week 1: Respond, Start, Keep It Going
note: Each week is written at the end of the previous one, from his results.

steps.title: Welcome!
steps.en:
In this app you learn by speaking. Every day has 4 sessions: Learn, Meet someone and talk, Listen and react, and Free chat. You talk to Sam and Maya, two friends from your class.
Tap the mic to speak English. Tap සිං when you're stuck and say it in Sinhala: the app helps you say it in English.
steps.si:
මෙම යෙදුමේ ඔබ කතා කරමින් ඉගෙන ගන්නවා. සෑම දිනකම සැසි 4ක් තියෙනවා: ඉගෙනීම, කෙනෙක් හමුවී කතා කිරීම, අහලා ප්‍රතිචාර දැක්වීම, සහ නිදහස් කතාව. ඔබ කතා කරන්නේ ඔබේ පන්තියේ යාළුවන් දෙදෙනෙක් වන Sam සහ Maya සමඟ.
ඉංග්‍රීසියෙන් කතා කිරීමට mic එක ඔබන්න. හිරවුණොත් සිං ඔබා සිංහලෙන් කියන්න: යෙදුම එය ඉංග්‍රීසියෙන් කියන්න උදව් කරයි.

lines: Hey! I'm Sam. I'm in your English class. I'm a huge Marvel fan. Iron Man, Thor, all of them!
Hi, I'm Maya. I'm in your class too. I love Hannibal, and Batman is way better than Marvel. Sorry, Sam!

steps.prompt: So, what's your name? Tell me a little about yourself!
models: Hi Sam! I'm [his name]. I'm a student, and I really love movies.
Hi! My name is [his name]. Nice to meet you. I like movies, especially the Avengers.
steps.point: Say hello, your name, and one thing about you.

steps.topic: What movies do you love? Thor? Batman? Mad Max? Tell Maya about your favourite movies and why you like them.

steps.en: Your voice goes to Google's speech service, which turns it into words. Your words go to Google's free Gemini AI, so Sam and Maya can understand and help you. Google may use what you say on the free service to improve its AI, so don't say private things like passwords or bank numbers. Your recordings, words and results stay on this phone until you remove the app.
steps.si: ඔබේ හඬ Google හි කථන සේවාවට යයි; එය ඔබේ කතාව වචන බවට පත් කරයි. ඔබේ වචන Google හි නොමිලේ ලැබෙන Gemini AI වෙත යයි, Sam සහ Maya ට ඔබව තේරුම් ගෙන උදව් කිරීමට. නොමිලේ සේවාවේදී ඔබ කියන දේ Google තම AI දියුණු කිරීමට භාවිතා කළ හැකියි, එබැවින් මුරපද හෝ බැංකු අංක වැනි පුද්ගලික දේ කියන්න එපා. ඔබේ හඬ පටිගත කිරීම්, වචන සහ ප්‍රතිඵල ඔබ යෙදුම ඉවත් කරන තුරු මෙම දුරකථනයේම තිබේ.

steps.title: When you don't catch something, ask!
steps.en:
Never go silent. Ask in English:
• Too fast: "Sorry, could you slow down a bit?"
• Didn't catch it: "Sorry, I didn't catch that."
• One word: "Sorry, what does ___ mean?"
• Hear it again: "Again, please." / "One more time?"
Asking is a good conversation skill. It never loses points.
steps.si:
කවදාවත් නිශ්ශබ්ද වෙන්න එපා. ඉංග්‍රීසියෙන් අහන්න:
• වේගවත් නම්: "Sorry, could you slow down a bit?"
• ඇහුණේ නැත්නම්: "Sorry, I didn't catch that."
• එක වචනයක්: "Sorry, what does ___ mean?"
• නැවත අහන්න: "Again, please."
ඇසීම හොඳ කතා කිරීමේ හැකියාවක්. ලකුණු අඩු වෙන්නේ නැහැ.

steps.prompt: So yesterday I went to the cinema with my cousins and we watched the new Marvel film and it was absolutely incredible and then we went for pizza and—
models: Whoa, slow down a bit!
Sorry, could you slow down a bit?
steps.point: Sam is talking too fast on purpose. Ask him to slow down.

steps.prompt: Lecter is such an enigmatic character, don't you think?
models: Sorry, what does 'enigmatic' mean?
What's 'enigmatic'?
steps.point: Maya used a word you may not know. Ask what it means.

steps.prompt: Tell me one thing you did today. If a word is missing, tap සිං and say that part in Sinhala.
models: I watched a movie today.
I went to class and then I came home.
steps.point: Practise the switch: English, then සිං for the missing word, then back to EN.

steps.title: Your starting point
steps.en: Just do your best. These answers are your starting point: at the end of the week you'll hear them again and see how far you've come.
steps.si: ඔබට හැකි උපරිමය කරන්න. මෙම පිළිතුරු ඔබේ ආරම්භක ලක්ෂ්‍යයයි: සතිය අවසානයේ ඔබට ඒවා නැවත අසා ඔබ කොතරම් දියුණු වී ඇත්දැයි බලන්න පුළුවන්.

steps.prompt: Nice haircut!
You look tired today.
Hey, are you a movie fan?
Your English is good!
Long time no see!

steps.topic: Tell me about yourself: who you are, what you do, what you like.

ideas: Which is better: Marvel or Batman?
steps.brief: First taste: an easy chat. Sam and Maya disagree about a film and ask what he thinks. No score.

days.title: Respond to compliments and a first meeting
days.sound: v / w: very, movie, Avengers vs well, wow, watch, what
days.review: Tell Maya about yourself and the movies you love.

steps.title: Today: respond, don't just answer
steps.en:
When someone says something nice or surprising, don't stop at "Thanks."
Pattern: React → add a detail with a connector → bounce it back.
New connectors: actually · because · by the way.
Long reply for friends; short reply ("Oh, thanks!" + a smile) when the moment is short.
steps.si:
කවුරුහරි හොඳ හෝ පුදුම දෙයක් කිව්වම "Thanks." කියලා නවතින්න එපා.
රටාව: ප්‍රතිචාරය → connector එකක් සමඟ විස්තරයක් → ආපසු ප්‍රශ්නයක්.
නව connectors: actually (ඇත්තටම) · because (නිසා; ඉංග්‍රීසියේ හේතුව පස්සේ) · by the way (කතාවට).
යාළුවන්ට දිගු පිළිතුරක්; කෙටි මොහොතකට කෙටි පිළිතුරක්.

lines: Oh, thanks! I actually got it yesterday, because I have an interview next week. By the way, I like your shirt.
Or, if there's no time: Oh, thanks!
steps.note: Listen to the pattern: react, detail with actually and because, bounce back.

steps.prompt: Nice haircut!
models: Oh, thanks! I actually got it yesterday, because I have an interview next week. By the way, I like your shirt.
Oh, thank you! I actually got it this morning, because it was too long. By the way, where do you get yours cut?
steps.point: React, add a detail with because, bounce it back.
steps.si: ප්‍රතිචාරය + because සමඟ හේතුව + ආපසු ප්‍රශ්නයක්.

steps.prompt: Did you cut it yourself?
models: No, I got it at the barber.
Haha, no! I got it at the barber near my house.
steps.point: "I cut it" means YOU cut it. Say "I got it…"
steps.si: "I cut it" කිව්වොත් ඔබම කැපුවා කියන එකයි. "I got it…" කියන්න.

steps.prompt: Hi! You must be new in this class.
models: Oh, yes! I actually started today. I'm [his name], by the way. How long have you been here?
Yes, it's my first day, actually. I'm [his name]. Is the teacher strict?
steps.point: Detail + your name + bounce it back.

steps.prompt: Hey, are you a movie fan?
models: Oh, yes! I actually love movies, especially the Avengers, but my favourite is Hannibal. What about you?
Yes, a big one! I watch a movie almost every night, because it helps me relax. By the way, have you seen Endgame?

steps.prompt: Your English is good!
models: Oh, really? Thanks! I'm practising every day, because I want to watch movies without subtitles. How did you learn yours?
Oh, thank you! I'm still learning.
steps.point: Accept the compliment. Don't say "No, it's bad."

steps.where: The college canteen, your first day in a new class
steps.en: It's your first day in a new class. At the canteen, Sam (from your class) comes over. He'll give you a few compliments, then talk about movies. You don't know exactly what he'll say. Use the pattern, ask him things back, and keep it going.
steps.si: අද නව පන්තියේ ඔබේ පළමු දිනයයි. ආපනශාලාවේදී Sam (ඔබේ පන්තියෙන්) ඔබ ළඟට එනවා. ඔහු ප්‍රශංසා කිහිපයක් කර චිත්‍රපට ගැන කතා කරයි. ඔහු කියන දේ හරියටම දන්නේ නැහැ. රටාව භාවිත කරන්න, ආපසු ප්‍රශ්න අහන්න, කතාව දිගටම ගෙනියන්න.
steps.goal: Use the pattern; ask back 3+ times; 8+ turns.
steps.brief: You meet him on his first day in a new class at the canteen. Give him 3 compliments (haircut, shirt, his English) one at a time, then talk about movies. Once, speak a little fast on purpose so he practises asking you to slow down.
steps.opener: Hey! You're new, right? Nice haircut, by the way!
steps.title: New classmate
Why Maya loves Batman
steps.script: Okay, so, why do I love Batman? Well, first, he has no superpowers. He's just a man, and he's really smart. Second, the stories are dark and serious, not silly. My favourite is The Dark Knight, because the Joker is brilliant. And honestly, Batman is just cooler than Iron Man. Sorry, Sam!
questions: Why does Maya say Batman is special?
Do you agree with her? Why or why not?
Ask Maya one question about Batman.

steps.title: Reaction sounds
steps.en:
Real listeners make small sounds. A flat "Oh." sounds bored; a rising "Oh!" sounds interested.
• Oh! / Oh, really? — surprise, interest
• Oh no! / I'm sorry to hear that. — bad news
• Wow! / Oh, nice! / That's great! — good news
• Ah, I see. / Right. / Uh-huh. — I'm listening
• Hmm… — thinking
• No way! — shocking or funny
steps.si:
සැබෑ සවන්දෙන්නෝ කුඩා ශබ්ද කරති. "Oh." පැතලි නම් කම්මැලි ලෙස ඇසේ; ඉහළ යන "Oh!" උනන්දුවක් පෙන්වයි.
• Oh! — පුදුමය, උනන්දුව
• Oh no! — නරක පුවතක්
• Wow! / Oh, nice! — හොඳ පුවතක්
• Ah, I see. / Uh-huh. — මම අහගෙන ඉන්නවා
• Hmm… — හිතනවා
• No way! — විහිළුවක් හෝ කම්පනයක්

items.news: I passed my driving test yesterday!
My phone fell in the lake.
They're making a new Hannibal film!
I'm thinking of learning the guitar.

steps.topic: Tell Maya about yourself and the movies you love.

days.title: Respond to comments, catching up and teasing
days.sound: f / p: film, favourite, funny vs pen, park, popcorn
days.review: How have you been this week? What did you watch?

steps.title: Today: comments and teasing
steps.en:
Friends say things like "You look tired" or "Late again?". Laugh → admit it or play along → add a detail → move on with "anyway".
New connectors: so · that's why · anyway.
steps.si:
යාළුවන් "You look tired" හෝ "Late again?" වගේ දේවල් කියනවා. හිනාවෙන්න → පිළිගන්න නැත්නම් විහිළුවට එකඟ වෙන්න → විස්තරයක් → "anyway" සමඟ ඉදිරියට.
නව connectors: so (ඒ නිසා) · that's why (ඒකයි) · anyway (කොහොම හරි).

steps.prompt: You look tired.
models: Yeah, a bit. I slept late because I was watching Infinity War again. Have you seen it?
Honestly, yes. I had a long day, that's why. But I'm OK!
steps.point: "a bit" makes it softer; "that's why" goes at the end.

steps.prompt: Long time no see!
models: Oh, yes! It's been ages! I was busy at home, so I didn't go out much. How have you been?
I know! I was studying a lot. Anyway, how are you?

steps.prompt: Late again?
models: Haha, sorry! The bus was late because of the rain. Anyway, I'm here now!
Sorry, sorry! The bus!
steps.point: Laugh first; because of + a thing; anyway.

steps.prompt: Hannibal again? Aren't you scared?
models: Haha, no way! I actually like it, because Lecter is so clever and calm. Anyway, you should watch it!
A little, honestly! But the story is so good, so I keep watching.
steps.point: Laugh, play along, move on with anyway.

steps.where: A video call from Maya after a long time
steps.en: Maya calls you on video after a long time. She wants to catch up, and she'll tease you a couple of times (about Marvel!). Laugh, play along, and keep it going.
steps.si: බොහෝ කාලෙකට පස්සේ Maya ඔබට වීඩියෝ ඇමතුමක් ගන්නවා. ඇයට අලුත් විස්තර දැනගන්න ඕනේ, ඇය ඔබට (Marvel ගැන!) දෙපාරක් විහිළු කරයි. හිනාවෙන්න, එකඟ වෙන්න, කතාව ගෙනියන්න.
steps.brief: You call him on video after a long time to catch up. Tease him twice, e.g. "Still watching Marvel? Batman is better!".
steps.opener: Hey! Long time no see! Where have you been?
steps.title: Catching up
Sam's voice message
steps.script: Hey, it's Sam! So, my weekend was crazy. On Saturday I went to my cousin's birthday party, and we played cricket till it got dark. Then on Sunday I watched Thor: Ragnarok again. It's so funny! Anyway, call me back, okay?
questions: What did Sam do on Saturday?
What do you think of Sam's weekend?
Ask Sam one question about his weekend.

items.news: I lost my wallet on the bus.
I got tickets for the new Avengers film!
My little brother ate my birthday cake.
I'm moving to Kandy next month.

steps.topic: How have you been this week? What did you watch?

days.title: Start a conversation (openers)
days.sound: th: think, thanks, three, Thor and this, that, the, they
days.review: Start a conversation with someone in a cinema queue.

steps.title: Today: you speak first
steps.en:
Pattern: Notice → comment or question → add yourself → hand over.
Example: "Hot today, isn't it? I'm actually sweating already. How about you?"
If the other person answers coldly ("Yes."), ask a second question. If it's going nowhere: "Anyway, nice talking to you!"
steps.si:
රටාව: දකින්න → අදහසක් හෝ ප්‍රශ්නයක් → ඔබ ගැන ටිකක් → අනෙකාට භාර දෙන්න.
isn't it? = නේද? · How about you? = ඔයාට කොහොමද?

steps.title: Today: keep them talking
steps.en:
React with the right sound, then ask a follow-up question.
• What happened: And then? · What did you do?
• Feelings: How did you feel? · Were you scared?
• Details: Where was that? · Who was with you?
• Opinion: Did you like it?

steps.si: Maya ඔබට දුරකථනයෙන් පුවත් කිහිපයක් කියයි: හොඳ දෙයක්, නරක දෙයක් සහ විහිළු දෙයක් (එකක් චිත්‍රපටයක් ගැන). දුරකථනයේදී මුහුණක් නැති නිසා හඬින් ප්‍රතිචාර දක්වා, ප්‍රශ්න අසා, නොතේරුණොත් අහන්න.
steps.goal: Right reaction every time; 6+ follow-ups; ask once when unsure; 12+ turns.

steps.title: Words first
steps.en: brilliant = very, very clever · dangerous = can hurt you · revenge = hurting someone back · enemy = a person against you · escape = get away
steps.si: brilliant = ඉතා දක්ෂ · dangerous = අනතුරුදායක · revenge = පළිගැනීම · enemy = සතුරා · escape = පැනයාම

steps.title: Story shape
steps.en:
Hook → first → then → meanwhile → suddenly → in the end → how I felt.
Hooks: "You won't believe what happened…" · "Guess what?" · "Have you seen…? It's about…"
steps.si: කතාවේ හැඩය: ආකර්ෂණය → මුලින්ම → ඊට පස්සේ → ඒ අතරේ (meanwhile) → හදිස්සියේම (suddenly) → අන්තිමට (in the end) → මට දැනුණු දේ.

lines: You won't believe what happened yesterday. First, I woke up late, because my phone was dead. Then I ran to the bus stop, but the bus was leaving. Meanwhile, it started raining! Suddenly, my friend stopped his bike and gave me a ride. In the end, I was only five minutes late. I was so lucky!
steps.note: A 1-minute story from life. Listen for meanwhile, suddenly, in the end.

steps.prompt: So, what happened to you this week? Tell me a short story!
steps.point: Use first, then, suddenly, in the end.

steps.prompt: I've never seen Hannibal. What's it about?
models: Hannibal is about a brilliant but dangerous man called Hannibal Lecter. At the start, he's living secretly in Italy. Meanwhile, an FBI agent called Clarice is in trouble at work. Then a rich man who wants revenge starts hunting Lecter. Suddenly, Lecter is caught, but Clarice saves him, even though he's her enemy. In the end, he escapes again. I love it because Lecter is so calm and clever.
steps.point: Retell the film in about a minute.

steps.si: Sam Hannibal බලලා නැහැ, ඔහු හිතන්නේ එය බය හිතෙන චිත්‍රපටයක් කියලා. ඔබේ ජීවිතයෙන් කතාවක් කියා චිත්‍රපටය නැවත කියන්න. ඔහුගේ ප්‍රශ්නවලට පිළිතුරු දී එය බලන්න ඔහුව ඒත්තු ගන්වන්න.
steps.goal: Tell 2 stories; answer follow-ups; convince Sam.

steps.title: Today: the whole conversation
steps.en:
Start → respond → keep it going → tell a story → close.
Buy time instead of freezing: "Well…" · "Let me think…" · "I mean…"
Close politely: "Anyway, I'd better go. It was nice talking to you!" · "Sorry, my bus is here. Nice meeting you!"
steps.si:
පටන් ගන්න → ප්‍රතිචාර දක්වන්න → දිගටම ගෙනියන්න → කතාවක් කියන්න → අවසන් කරන්න.

steps.prompt: So, when are YOU getting married?

steps.point: A surprise question: buy time, then answer.

steps.prompt: Better than Endgame? What do YOU think?

steps.point: Give an opinion and keep the peace.

steps.en: You're at your cousin's wedding. Your uncle comes over to chat, and he likes to tease. He might ask when YOU are getting married! Start or respond naturally, keep it going, tell a short story, and close politely.
steps.si: ඔබ ඔබේ ඥාති සහෝදරයාගේ මංගල උත්සවයේ. ඔබේ මාමා කතා කරන්න එනවා, ඔහු විහිළු කරන්න කැමතියි. ඔහු "ඔයා කවදද කසාද බඳින්නේ?" කියා අහන්න පුළුවන්! ස්වාභාවිකව කතා කර, කතාවක් කියා, ආචාරශීලීව අවසන් කරන්න.
steps.goal: Reaction sounds, follow-ups, one longer answer, a time-buyer instead of silence, a polite close; 12+ turns.
